description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayEnvironment component, focusing on parsing semantic versions, normalizing version output, compatibility checks, default gateway port behavior, and version extraction from strings.

methods.name: semver parses common forms
methods.description: Tests the parsing of various semantic version strings, including stripping prefixes, suffixes, and handling invalid inputs.

methods.name: gateway version output strips product prefix before parsing
methods.description: Ensures that the gateway version output string is correctly normalized by removing the product prefix before parsing.

methods.name: semver compatibility requires same major and not older
methods.description: Checks semantic version compatibility criteria, ensuring same major version and that the candidate is not older.

methods.name: gateway port defaults and respects override
methods.description: Verifies that the gateway port defaults correctly and can be overridden via user defaults.

methods.name: expected gateway version from string uses parser
methods.description: Tests extracting and parsing the expected gateway version from version strings, including handling nil.
